doc: Blind holdout 4: 140 rows (100 off/biz + 40 child, seed 20261025) the first Rust port demoted, none seen while tuning, labelled W (a young individual can use it) or R. Its 6 W rows (4.3%) tuned the S1 person-cue exception, 일반국민/일반인 and the S4 adult-reach exceptions, so it is no longer blind.
